reason: This plugin is an external-service integration for DeepSeek Harness that connects a FolioDrop account and publishes agent-approved content as shareable FolioDrop URLs; evidence in the README shows OAuth-based connection, credential storage, content type conversion to HTML, and explicit publish confirmation, while package metadata shows it is a DeepSeek Harness plugin package.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中连接 FolioDrop，并将用户确认的内容发布为可分享的 FolioDrop 链接。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DeepSeek Harness to FolioDrop and lets users publish approved content as shareable FolioDrop URLs.

capabilities: stores and reuses a dedicated API key in Harness credentials
uploads/transforms content to publish as shareable URLs
uses fixed external host (foliodrop.app) for publishing
requires explicit user confirmation before publishing
